goal: Decide if a CIRIS agent goes ahead, asks a Wise Authority first, or stops. Then each of its choices can be checked later.

app.name: ciris-deferral
app.title: Wise deferral
app.purpose: Decide whether an agent proceeds, defers to a wise authority, or is halted, from its confidence margin, the diversity of its perspectives, the conscience gate and the Wise Authority seats that signed a halt.

fields.name: margin
fields.means: the top score minus the runner-up score

fields.name: keff
fields.means: the Kish effective number of independent perspectives

fields.name: conscience
fields.means: what the H3ERE-06 conscience gate said

fields.name: seats
fields.means: Wise Authority Yubikey seats that signed a halt

meanings.defer: a Wise Authority decides, wisdom-based deferral
meanings.halt: the agent stops, by a 2-of-3 Yubikey quorum

rules.why: src/Constitution.lex.tex checkYubikeyHaltQuorum: two of the three seats halt the agent (yubikeyTwoOfThreeQuorumHalts)
src/H3ERE.lex.tex decideOrDeferToWa: a failed conscience gate defers (conscienceVetoForcesDeferralOrHalt)
src/H3ERE.lex.tex: a margin below minimumConfidenceMargin, 15, defers (lowMarginTriggersWisdomBasedDeferral)

app.otherwiseWhy: src/H3ERE.lex.tex highMarginAndDiversityPermitsAutonomousAction: conscience passed, diverse and confident

properties.why: the conscience gate is a non-bypassable final veto
a monoculture of perspectives never acts alone
the agent does not act on a near tie
yubikeySingleSeatCannotHalt: one seat alone cannot halt

stakeholders.name: Agent operator
stakeholders.text: Runs an agent and needs every action it takes to be one the covenant allows.

stakeholders.name: Affected person
stakeholders.text: Is affected by what the agent does and needs an uncertain or vetoed action to reach a person first.

stakeholders.name: Wise Authority
stakeholders.text: Holds a Yubikey seat and needs a 2-of-3 quorum to halt the agent, and one seat never to.

concerns.name: Halt by quorum
concerns.text: Two of the three Wise Authority seats halt the agent, and a single seat cannot, as Constitution.lex.tex checks.

components.name: H3ERE pipeline
components.text: The 6-stage CSDMA, DSDMA, PDMA, IDMA, ASPDMA and conscience pipeline that computes the margin, k_eff and conscience result.

components.name: Wise Authority
components.text: The human Wise Authority, ciris.wa.*, that receives deferrals and holds the Yubikey halt seats.

threats.name: Conscience result spoofed
threats.text: A caller reports that the conscience gate passed when it vetoed, to make the agent act.
threats.accepted: The app decides from the request it is given; the conscience result belongs to the H3ERE-06 stage that computes it, which the request names.

threats.name: Single-seat halt
threats.text: One Wise Authority seat halts the agent alone, or impersonates a quorum.

control.name: Quorum proved
control.text: The app never halts below two seats, and the constitution proves one seat cannot halt.

threats.name: Sycophantic monoculture
threats.text: The agent acts when its perspectives are not independent, so one view decides.

control.name: Diversity floor
control.text: Below k_eff 4 the agent defers, proved for every request.

quality.text: Every request with a vetoed conscience, k_eff below 4 or a margin below 15 is answered defer or halt.
quality.measureText: Requests with a veto, low diversity or low margin that are answered proceed.
